name: WordPress with OpenLiteSpeed
description: WordPress powered by OpenLiteSpeed web server with MySQL database. Includes persistent volumes for WordPress files, OLS configuration, logs, and database data.

variables.label: WordPress Database Password

variables.name: WORDPRESS_DEBUG
